# Elden Ring Flick stick configuration
RESET_MAPPINGS

REAL_WORLD_CALIBRATION = 400		# Change if making a full circle with right stick doesn't move character camera in the same way.
IN_GAME_SENS = 50					# Should be same as in game



R = LMOUSE     
CALIBRATE = L
##### START AND SELECT
+ = ESC G          					# Pause, Map
- = 5 6

#############
TOUCHPAD_MODE = GRID_AND_STICK
GRID_SIZE = 2 2   					# split the pad in 4 buttons, 2 left and 2 right
GYRO_ON = TOUCH    				# disable the gyro when I touch

# Bind on clicks

CAPTURE = NONE   					# Chorded with touch buttons
T1,CAPTURE = 1  					# 
T2,CAPTURE = 2 						#
T3,CAPTURE = 3						#
T4,CAPTURE = 4						#
#############

#TUTORIAL
#PS = 								# --- 						(Ps button)
#CAPTURE =          				# ---						(Touchpad click)
#TOUCH = 							# --- 						(Touchpad touch)
#Use W = R E    		    		# if you want E on hold button

#https://github.com/Electronicks/JoyShockMapper#commands - good list of commands and inputs

# Include mouse settings
# If you are not happy with sensitivity change it in that file.
